mentions.name: ikverdienbeter.nl (i deserve better)
mentions.description: This platform educates people on recognizing healthy behaviour and healthy boundaries by taking snippets from popular TV, such as dating shows, and marking red flags on a timeline (e.g., pointing out gaslighting with an explanation). It uses AI for auto subtitles and actor matching, and plans an auto-deploy feature to publish short fragments to social media like TikTok.
mentions.audience: General public learning to recognize healthy behaviour and boundaries
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a platform called ikverdienbeter.nl (i deserve better) that educates people on recognizing healthy behaviour and healthy boundaries. I take snippets from popular tv, like dating shows, and mark the "red flags" on a timeline.
